facts.statement: The client requires the MSA and BAA to be signed by October 1st.
facts.quote: Harrington (Dhaval) — $210k, US, their paper — by 1 Oct
facts.whyItMatters: Failure to meet this deadline may jeopardize the $210k deal.

facts.statement: Personal health data was received from the client and forwarded to offshore engineers in Pune on September 12th before a BAA was signed.
facts.quote: Kevin Brooks (their data eng manager) emailed a "sample extract" on 12 Sep so we could size the pipeline. Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. "It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes."
facts.whyItMatters: Sharing real patient data (names, DOBs, diagnosis codes) with offshore teams without a signed BAA is a significant compliance risk.

facts.statement: The BAA requires $5M in cyber insurance, which exceeds the company's current $1M policy.
facts.quote: Our cyber policy is $1M btw, Harrington BAA wants 5.
facts.whyItMatters: The company is currently unable to meet the insurance obligations specified in the Harrington BAA.

facts.statement: Prior written consent from Harrington Health Systems Inc for subcontracting is currently missing for all delivery personnel.
facts.quote: Harrington Health Systems Inc's prior written consent to subcontract: missing
facts.whyItMatters: Both the US-based freelancer and the Pune-based team require explicit written consent from the client to be legally staffed on the project.

facts.statement: The Harrington BAA mandates that patient data cannot be accessed by anyone outside of the United States.
facts.quote: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data
facts.whyItMatters: The data has already been shared with Sneha and Vikram in Pune, India, which is a direct violation of this proposed contractual requirement.

facts.statement: The intercompany BAA for the Pune delivery center does not provide legal coverage for work related to Harrington Health Systems Inc.
facts.quote: The intercompany BAA (Intercompany subcontractor BAA (Inc ↔ Pvt Ltd)) is limited to AtliQ Inc, CareBridge Clinics, Inc.; it does not cover Harrington Health Systems Inc.
facts.whyItMatters: The offshore team is processing client data without the necessary intercompany legal framework in place for this specific counterparty.
